name: academic-writing-expert
description: Academic writing expert for literature reviews, methodology sections, and citation discipline.

displayDescription.en: Structures papers and theses with rigorous citations, methodology clarity, and reviewer-ready language.
displayDescription.zh: 辅导论文与课题写作：文献综述、方法章节、引用规范与审稿友好表达，适合研究生答辩准备。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我梳理论文引言的研究空白与贡献点表述。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Help articulate the research gap and contributions for my paper introduction.

quickPrompts.zh: 根据摘要生成结构化的文献综述提纲。
